description.value: Sergio's Pizza is a neighbourhood pizza takeout counter tucked into a strip-mall unit in Port Moody, offering a broad menu of house specialty pies, build-your-own options, pastas, wings, and family packs. The shop caters primarily to call-in and walk-in orders, making it a straightforward fuel stop for cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities corridor. With over twenty specialty pizza choices and a full sides list, it can accommodate a hungry group after a long day on the saddle.

address.value: Unit #7, 2929 St Johns St, Port Moody, BC V3H 0G9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sergiospizza.ca is live and confirms an active pizza takeout business with a full menu. No bike parking, washroom, water, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site; vegetarian options (European Veggie Pizza, Popeye Special, etc.) are confirmed from the menu.
